use crawlberg::batch_scrape;
use crawlberg::create_engine;

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() {
    let engine = create_engine(None).expect("handle creation should succeed");
    let urls: Vec<String> = [r#"https://example.com/target"#, r#"https://example.com/other"#].into_iter().map(str::to_string).collect();
    let _ = batch_scrape(&engine, urls).await;
    println!("{:?}", result.total_count);
    println!("{:?}", result.completed_count);
}
